startedSound: A sound plays for new work. Keep this app open.
startedMuted: Sound is muted on this device. Turn it on with the speaker button.
ended: Shift ended. The screen may turn off again.

wake.checking: Checking whether the screen can stay awake…
wake.on: The screen stays awake while this app is open.
wake.unsupported: This browser can't keep the screen awake. Keep the app open and set the screen to stay on in the device settings.
wake.insecure: The screen can only be kept awake on the app's secure (https) address. Keep the screen on yourself for now.
wake.denied: The device did not allow keeping the screen awake (battery saver?). Keep the screen on yourself.
wake.timeout: The device did not answer, so the screen may turn off. Keep the screen on yourself.
